[{"word":"cradle","pronun":"[ˈkreɪdl]","translation":"n. 摇篮；发源地；发祥地；支船架
vt. 抚育；把...搁在支架上；把...放在摇篮内","audio":"cradle.mp3"},{"word":"crash","pronun":"[kræʃ]","translation":"n. 撞碎；坠毁；破产；轰隆声；睡觉
vi. 摔碎；坠落；发出隆隆声；(金融企业等)破产
vt. 打碎；使坠毁、撞坏；擅自闯入","audio":"crash.mp3"},{"word":"crawl","pronun":"[krɔːl]","translation":"n. 爬行；养鱼池；匍匐而行
vt. 爬行；缓慢地行进
vi. 爬行；匍匐行进","audio":"crawl.mp3"},{"word":"creation","pronun":"[kriˈeɪʃn]","translation":"n. 创造，创作；创作物，产物","audio":"creation.mp3"},{"word":"credible","pronun":"[ˈkredəbl]","translation":"adj. 可靠的，可信的","audio":"credible.mp3"},{"word":"credit","pronun":"[ˈkredɪt]","translation":"n. 信用，信誉；[金融] 贷款；学分；信任；声望
vt. 相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂","audio":"credit.mp3"},{"word":"crew","pronun":"[kruː]","translation":"n. 队，组；全体人员，全体船员
vt. 使当船员
vi. 一起工作","audio":"crew.mp3"},{"word":"crime","pronun":"[kraɪm]","translation":"n. 罪行，犯罪；罪恶；犯罪活动
vt. 控告……违反纪律","audio":"crime.mp3"},{"word":"criminal","pronun":"[ˈkrɪmɪnl]","translation":"n. 罪犯
adj. 刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的","audio":"criminal.mp3"},{"word":"cripple","pronun":"[ˈkrɪpl]","translation":"n. 跛子；残废
vt. 削弱；使跛；使残废
adj. 跛的；残废的","audio":"cripple.mp3"},{"word":"crisis","pronun":"[ˈkraɪsɪs]","translation":"n. 危机；危险期；决定性时刻
adj. 危机的；用于处理危机的","audio":"crisis.mp3"},{"word":"crisp","pronun":"[krɪsp]","translation":"adj. 脆的；新鲜的；易碎的
vt. 使卷曲；使发脆
vi. 卷曲；发脆
n. 松脆物；油炸马铃薯片","audio":"crisp.mp3"},{"word":"criterion","pronun":"[kraɪˈtɪriən]","translation":"n. （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据","audio":"criterion.mp3"},{"word":"critic","pronun":"[ˈkrɪtɪk]","translation":"n. 批评家，评论家；爱挑剔的人","audio":"critic.mp3"},{"word":"critical","pronun":"[ˈkrɪtɪkl]","translation":"adj. 鉴定的；[核] 临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的","audio":"critical.mp3"},{"word":"criticism","pronun":"[ˈkrɪtɪsɪzəm]","translation":"n. 批评；考证；苛求","audio":"criticism.mp3"},{"word":"criticize","pronun":"[ˈkrɪtɪsaɪz]","translation":"vi. 批评；评论；苛求
vt. 批评；评论；非难","audio":"criticize.mp3"},{"word":"crowd","pronun":"[kraʊd]","translation":"n. 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众
v. 拥挤,挤满,挤进
vt. 挤满,将...塞进;催促,催逼
vi. 挤,拥挤,聚集","audio":"crowd.mp3"},{"word":"crucial","pronun":"[ˈkruːʃl]","translation":"adj. 重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的","audio":"crucial.mp3"},{"word":"crumble","pronun":"[ˈkrʌmbl]","translation":"n. 面包屑
vi. 崩溃；破碎，粉碎
vt. 崩溃；弄碎，粉碎","audio":"crumble.mp3"}]
